summary: Hosted Claude in Chrome used the sandbox OAuth connector to verify NHL goalie status and injury updates. All seven expanded pages displayed without truncation and three cursor chains reached a null final cursor. The November 9 slate returned six goalie observations across three games, including five confirmed and one expected. NYR–EDM and DET–STL returned 18 flags across four complete injury reports. Both DET–STL reports correctly showed stale source timestamps. Compared identities, statuses, source and timestamp fields matched PostgreSQL. Both sandbox flags were restored to unset. The client fields retain historical versions. See docs/nhl-lineup-availability-acceptance.md for the rollout and pending owner review.
